001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamConverter.path.XPath;
006import com.streamConverter.pathHandler.FixedStaXPathHandler;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.logging.Logger;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
020import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
021import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
022import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
023
024/**
025 * XML Navigate Command Class
026 *
027 * <p>This class implements command for targeted XML transformation using XPath. It identifies
028 * specific elements using XPath expressions and applies IRule transformations to those elements
029 * while preserving the overall XML structure.
030 */
031public class XmlNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
032  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlNavigateCommand.class.getName());
033  private static final XMLEventFactory EVENT_FACTORY = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
034
035  private XPath xpath;
036  private IRule rule;
037  private FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler;
038
039  // Deprecated fields for backward compatibility
040  @Deprecated private final String legacyXpath;
041
042  /**
043   * Constructor for XML navigation with XPath selector and transformation rule.
044   *
045   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
046   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
047   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
048   * @deprecated Use {@link #XmlNavigateCommand(XPath, IRule)} instead
049   */
050  @Deprecated
051  public XmlNavigateCommand(String xpath, IRule rule) {
052    if (rule == null) {
053      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
054    }
055    this.legacyXpath = xpath;
056    this.xpath = xpath != null ? new XPath(xpath) : null;
057    this.rule = rule;
058    if (xpath != null) {
059      this.pathHandler = new FixedStaXPathHandler(xpath);
060    }
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Constructor for XML navigation with typed XPath selector and transformation rule.
065   *
066   * @param xpath the typed XPath to select elements
067   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
068   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
069   */
070  public XmlNavigateCommand(XPath xpath, IRule rule) {
071    if (rule == null) {
072      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
073    }
074    this.xpath = xpath;
075    this.legacyXpath = xpath != null ? xpath.getPath() : null;
076    this.rule = rule;
077    if (xpath != null) {
078      this.pathHandler = new FixedStaXPathHandler(xpath.getPath());
079    }
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with explicit rule specification. This
084   * method makes the intention explicit: extract data from the specified XPath and apply the given
085   * transformation rule.
086   *
087   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
088   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
089   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that extracts the specified XPath with the given rule
090   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
091   * @deprecated Use {@link #create(XPath, IRule)} instead
092   */
093  @Deprecated
094  public static XmlNavigateCommand create(String xpath, IRule rule) {
095    return new XmlNavigateCommand(xpath, rule);
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with typed XPath and rule.
100   *
101   * @param xpath the typed XPath to select elements
102   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
103   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that extracts the specified XPath with the given rule
104   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
105   */
106  public static XmlNavigateCommand create(XPath xpath, IRule rule) {
107    return new XmlNavigateCommand(xpath, rule);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command that processes entire XML with explicit
112   * rule specification. This method makes the intention explicit: process all XML data with the
113   * given transformation rule.
114   *
115   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to entire XML
116   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that processes entire XML with the given rule
117   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
118   */
119  public static XmlNavigateCommand createForAll(IRule rule) {
120    return new XmlNavigateCommand((XPath) null, rule);
121  }
122
123  @Override
124  protected String getCommandDetails() {
125    if (xpath != null) {
126      return String.format("XmlNavigateCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath.getPath());
127    } else {
128      return "XmlNavigateCommand(entire XML)";
129    }
130  }
131
132  @Override
133  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
134      throws IOException {
135    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
136      if (xpath == null) {
137        // Apply rule to entire XML content
138        applyRuleToEntireXml(inputStream, writer);
139      } else {
140        // Apply rule to specific XPath elements while preserving structure
141        applyRuleToXmlPath(inputStream, writer);
142      }
143    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
144      throw new IOException("XML processing error", e);
145    }
146  }
147
148  /** Apply transformation rule to entire XML content */
149  private void applyRuleToEntireXml(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
150      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
151    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
152    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
153
154    try {
155      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
156      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
157      processXmlEvents(eventReader, eventWriter, (event, data) -> rule.apply(data));
158    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
159      handleXmlException(e);
160    } finally {
161      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
162    }
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Apply transformation rule to specific XPath elements while preserving XML structure This is a
167   * simplified implementation - production version would need proper XPath library
168   */
169  private void applyRuleToXmlPath(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
170      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
171    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
172    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
173
174    try {
175      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
176      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
177      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, pathHandler, rule);
178    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
179      handleXmlException(e);
180    } finally {
181      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
182    }
183  }
184
185  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
186      XMLEventReader eventReader,
187      XMLEventWriter eventWriter,
188      FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler,
189      IRule rule)
190      throws XMLStreamException {
191    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
192    boolean inTargetElement = false;
193    int targetDepth = 0;
194
195    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
196      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
197
198      if (event.isStartElement()) {
199        String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
200        currentPath.add(elementName);
201
202        if (pathHandler.isTarget(currentPath)) {
203          inTargetElement = true;
204          targetDepth = currentPath.size();
205          eventWriter.add(event);
206        } else if (inTargetElement) {
207          eventWriter.add(event);
208        }
209      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
210        if (inTargetElement) {
211          eventWriter.add(event);
212          if (currentPath.size() == targetDepth) {
213            inTargetElement = false;
214            // Add newline as simple characters
215            eventWriter.add(EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters("\n"));
216          }
217        }
218        currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
219      } else if (event.isCharacters() && inTargetElement) {
220        // Apply rule to character data in target elements
221        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
222        String transformedData = rule.apply(originalData);
223        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
224          // Create new character event with transformed data
225          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
226          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
227        } else {
228          eventWriter.add(event);
229        }
230      }
231    }
232  }
233
234  // Common factory methods and utilities
235  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
236    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
237    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
238    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
239      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
240    }
241    return reader;
242  }
243
244  private XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(Writer writer) throws XMLStreamException {
245    XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
246    return outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(writer);
247  }
248
249  private void handleXmlException(XMLStreamException e) throws IOException {
250    String message = e.getMessage();
251    if (message != null && (message.contains("unclosed") || message.contains("end"))) {
252      throw new IOException("Invalid XML format - unclosed tags", e);
253    }
254    throw new IOException("Invalid XML format", e);
255  }
256
257  @FunctionalInterface
258  private interface CharacterDataProcessor {
259    String process(XMLEvent event, String data);
260  }
261
262  private void processXmlEvents(
263      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, CharacterDataProcessor processor)
264      throws XMLStreamException {
265    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
266      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
267
268      if (event.isCharacters()) {
269        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
270        String transformedData = processor.process(event, originalData);
271
272        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
273          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
274          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
275        } else {
276          eventWriter.add(event);
277        }
278      } else {
279        eventWriter.add(event);
280      }
281    }
282    eventWriter.flush();
283  }
284
285  private void closeResources(XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter) {
286    if (eventReader != null) {
287      try {
288        eventReader.close();
289      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
290        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventReader: " + e.getMessage());
291      }
292    }
293    if (eventWriter != null) {
294      try {
295        eventWriter.close();
296      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
297        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventWriter: " + e.getMessage());
298      }
299    }
300  }
301}
